# Demolisher

Internal ID: SledgeDemolisher | Type: Club | Source: Black forge | Usage: Weapon | Wielding: Two-handed | Crafting Materials: Yggdrasil wood x6, Iron x45, Refined eitr x6 | Attack speed: 1.7 s | Hitbox: 2 range, 4 radius, sphere, no multitarget penalty | Movement speed: -15%

# Introduction

The Demolisher is the third two-handed club. It has no secondary attack. The primary attack slams the ground (after a lengthy swing delay), dealing damage, 2x staggering and knocking back everything in a spherical area of effect with a radius of four meters.

## Trivia

• The head of the Demolisher appears to be made of Black marble with some Copper components, including copper designs on the sides of the head depicting Yggdrasil. Despite these appearances, neither of those materials are used in its construction.
